description:
dev/studies/b488f02c/feasibility-study.md section 4.4 publishes two q=3 cells that disagree with its own committed artifact dev/studies/b488f02c/throughput-2026-08-07.csv at the table's shown precision: 18182 for (n=12, cpu_avx2) where the CSV's 18181.4619 renders 18181, and 30210 for (n=16, GPU M=256) where the CSV's 30209.4610 renders 30209. Both are +1 in the last shown digit; the table's other 5-to-6-digit integer cells reproduce their raw values exactly.

## Background

The first cell was found by the F_3 receipt campaign (047b62ed) when its analysis switched from quoting the table to parsing the CSV; the second by this issue's recorded check, whose significant-figure reading follows the table's own evident convention (integer cells carry all shown digits; e.g. 61306 reproduces 61306.0236 exactly). The F_3 receipts section 11.1 asserts only one divergent cell, because its checker read the trailing zero of 30210 as insignificant; that dependent claim is corrected in this issue's scope. cpu_avx2 and the M=256 GPU configuration set no best-path baseline at those orders, so no ratio or go/no-go input changes.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Both published section 4.4 cells agree with the committed CSV at the table's shown precision, and the correction commit cites this issue.
- [hard] REQ-02: A recorded check (script or command in the study directory) verifies every published section 4.4 q=3 cell against the CSV at each cell's shown precision, treating every shown digit of an integer cell as significant.
- [hard] REQ-03: The dependent claim in dev/studies/047b62ed/receipts.md section 11.1 is corrected to state both divergent cells and the significant-figure reading that distinguishes the counts, preserving the original observation record.

## Notes

Per @/inv/claims-trace-to-artifacts and @/inv/falsification-preserved. Owner-approved scope amendment 2026-08-15: second cell and the receipts correction added; 047b62ed remains closed, with this issue's doc-review gate covering the correction.
title: Feasibility study table cell disagrees with its own committed CSV
